requirement: Secrets of any kind - API keys, JWT/bearer tokens, LLM API keys, database credentials, private keys, connection strings, webhook secrets - must never be hardcoded as literal values in source code.
prohibited: Assigning a literal secret/token/key/password string to a variable, constant, or config value in code, instead of reading it from an environment variable or secrets manager.
detection: Secret scanner (e.g. Gitleaks, TruffleHog) + LLM review
remediation: Move the secret to an environment variable or secrets manager, remove it from source control history, and rotate the exposed credential.
